title: Tony Ezzy Gets a Job
overview: TWO WEEKS IN THE FUTURE: - it's a new season every day because of climate change - one out of one kids get diabetes from eating sugar - a new series of government reforms have eliminated government funding for everything except the military - big record labels have been given the right to patent all rhythms, destroying the the independent music industry overnight - Formerly independent musician Tony Ezzy suddenly has to get a job for the first time in 10 years. He is not adjusting very well.
